name: Configuration Entity View
description: Views handler implementation for configuration entities.
project_description:
This module provides allows site builders to create Views that are lists of Configuration. For example, a site builder can create lists of Roles, Menus, Image Styles, Content Types, Views, and so on.

 These lists can then be filtered and sorted, and turned into pages, exported in other formats, used as targets for Entity Reference fields, and so on - ie, leveraging the power of Views.

 The module comes also replaces admin list/manage pages of configuration entities (e.g content types, view modes, etc) with views so they can be subsequent customized to suit your purposes.

 Back to top 

 Detailed features 
 The following default pages are installed as Views ready for customization:

 
 Comment types - admin/structure/comment 
 Contact forms* - admin/structure/contact 
 Content types - admin/structure/types 
 Custom block library - admin/structure/block/block-content/types 
 Date and time formats* - admin/config/regional/date-time 
 Form modes* - admin/structure/display-modes/form 
 Menus - admin/structure/menu 
 Shortcuts - admin/config/user-interface/shortcut 
 Image styles - admin/config/media/image-styles 
 Taxonomy - admin/structure/taxonomy 
 Text formats* - admin/config/content/formats 
 User roles* - admin/people/roles 
 View modes* - admin/structure/display-modes/view 
 Views* - admin/structure/views (WHAT!!!) 
 
 Then created your own Views of anything else.

 *- These Views are disabled by default. Enable them via Admin > Structure >

Views to have them take over the list and start customizing them. 

 Back to top 

 Limitations / Known issues 
 
 Provides only limited fields (name, description etc) - Getting entity specific fields is Work in progress. 
 Few of the default views are not match with the core design - By default disabled. 
 Fields pages are not yet done.
